title: Interaction between MICO mode with active time and extended idle mode DRX cycle
text: The UE can request the use of both MICO mode with active time and eDRX during a registration procedure but it is up to the network to decide to enable none, one of them or both (see 3GPPTS23.501[8])

If the network accepts the use of both MICO mode with active time (see subclause5.3.6) and eDRX (see subclause5.3.16), the extended DRX parameters provided to the UE should allow for multiple paging occasions before the active timer expires
